CalibForge Daytona layers
	

This dataset mirrors the container image layers of the
CalibForge task pool by AweAI, released under
CC-BY-4.0. All credit for the tasks and their environments belongs
to the CalibForge authors (paper: arXiv 2608.06352). The upstream images are aweaiteam/calibforge on Docker Hub,
and we modified nothing in the layers.

	
		
	
	
		What is here
	


blobs/sha256/<first 2 hex>/<64 hex>: the layers of each task image above its shared base, as the registry… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/laion/calibforge-daytona-layers.
